description:
Get your fragrance cabinet — fragrances you own now (CURRENT), previously owned or tried (TRIED), or finished (FINISHED). Supports optional name/house search via `query`. Free for any signed-in account.

See also: `user_cabinet_set` to add or update bottles · `user_cabinet_remove` to remove a bottle · `fragrance_get` for full details on any fragrance.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

query.description: Filter your cabinet by fragrance or brand name
